scripts.build:wasm: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cd .. && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir frontend/pkg && rm -f frontend/pkg/.gitignore && cp frontend/pkg/varaix_bg.wasm frontend/public/varaix_bg.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:release: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cd .. && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir frontend/pkg && rm -f frontend/pkg/.gitignore && cp frontend/pkg/varaix_bg.wasm frontend/public/varaix_bg.wasm
scripts.vercel-build: if [ -n "$VERCEL" ]; then next build; else npm run build:wasm:release && next build; fi
